arguments.title: DINOv3
key_claims: Dense patch features are more suitable than one global semantic embedding for retaining local layout. The paper separates global discrimination from local consistency using Gram anchoring; this is a reason to inspect patch features, not to train a new foundation model here. The official21M ViT-S/16 is a bounded first candidate. Exact color fidelity and music-to-light transfer are unmeasured. Weights require an access process; verify access and checksum before execution. Preserve explicit HS/color targets and test low-semantic backgrounds, geometry and color perturbations.
